ex.en: Small firms often complain that bureaucracy makes it hard to start a business.
ex.zh: 小公司常抱怨官僚程序让创业变得困难。

words.note: bureau（局）+cracy（统治）；指繁复的行政程序，含贬义。

ex.en: The survey shows that women still do most of the household work.
ex.zh: 调查显示，女性仍承担大部分家务。

words.note: 作定语时意为“家庭的、家用的”，如 household chores。

ex.en: The skater glided smoothly across the ice without any visible effort.
ex.zh: 滑冰者毫不费力地平稳滑过冰面。

words.note: glide 强调无声、轻盈地滑动，与 slide（摩擦滑动）不同。

ex.en: The drug may cause adverse effects in patients with heart disease.
ex.zh: 该药可能对心脏病患者产生不良影响。

words.note: adverse 多修饰 effects、conditions 等抽象名词，不用于人。

ex.en: The evening news bulletin reported a sharp rise in food prices.
ex.zh: 晚间新闻简报报道食品价格大幅上涨。

words.note: bulletin 指简短公告或快讯；bulletin board 在美语中即公告栏。

ex.en: She devoted most of her free time to helping children in the village.
ex.zh: 她把大部分空闲时间用于帮助村里的孩子。

words.note: devote 后接 to，to 是介词，后跟名词或动名词。

ex.en: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the station.
ex.zh: 在下一个路口左转，你就会看到车站。

words.note: junction 指道路、铁路的交汇点；join 加 -tion 构成。

ex.en: The old stone wall has begun to crumble after years of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 多年暴雨之后，那堵旧石墙开始崩塌。

words.note: crumble 既可指物体碎裂，也可指制度、权威逐渐瓦解。

ex.en: The agent helped us find a cheaper flight to London.
ex.zh: 代理人帮我们找到了飞往伦敦更便宜的航班。

words.note: agent 由 act（做）+ent（人）构成，指代办事务的人或作用物。

ex.en: The debate over abortion has divided the country for many years.
ex.zh: 关于堕胎的争论已使这个国家分裂多年。

words.note: abortion 是医学和法律话题词，讨论时语气要中性客观。

ex.en: For many small shops, online sales proved to be their salvation.
ex.zh: 对许多小店来说，网络销售成了它们的救星。

words.note: salv（救）+ation；宗教语境指灵魂得救，日常指唯一出路。

ex.en: Her first instinct was to run, but she stayed and helped.
ex.zh: 她的第一反应是跑开，但她留下来帮忙。

words.note: instinct 指天生的本能；intuition 更偏后天积累的直觉。

ex.en: The old fort still has several cannons pointing toward the sea.
ex.zh: 这座旧堡垒仍有几门大炮朝向大海。

words.note: 注意拼写：cannon 大炮，canon 是“经典、教规”，勿混。

ex.en: The company plans to invest heavily in solar energy next year.
ex.zh: 公司计划明年大举投资太阳能。

words.note: invest in 后接领域或项目；invest 也可指投入时间、精力。

ex.en: The school has a good reputation for teaching languages to adults.
ex.zh: 这所学校因成人语言教学而享有良好声誉。

words.note: reputation 常与 good、damage 等词搭配，是可数名词。

ex.en: The team hopes to finish the research project by the end of June.
ex.zh: 团队希望六月底前完成这个研究项目。

words.note: 作名词重音在前，作动词重音在后；此处为名词用法。

ex.en: He simply shrugged his shoulders and said nothing about the mistake.
ex.zh: 他只是耸了耸肩，对那个错误什么也没说。

words.note: shrug off 表示轻视、不当回事，比 ignore 更口语。

ex.en: Thousands of fans filled the arena long before the game started.
ex.zh: 比赛开始前很久，数千名球迷就坐满了场馆。

words.note: arena 本义竞技场，引申为“活动舞台、角逐场所”。

ex.en: Moving out gave her a sense of independence she had never had.
ex.zh: 搬出去住给了她从未有过的独立感。

words.note: in（不）+depend（依赖）+ence；形容词是 independent。

ex.en: They planted low shrubs along the path to mark the border.
ex.zh: 他们沿小路种了低矮灌木来标示边界。

words.note: shrub 是矮小木本植物；bush 更口语，tree 指乔木。

ex.en: She gave a clear presentation on the new marketing plan.
ex.zh: 她清晰地介绍了新的营销计划。

words.note: give/make a presentation 均可；“做报告”不用 do。

ex.en: The committee nominated her for the award after reviewing her work.
ex.zh: 委员会在审阅她的工作后提名她获奖。

words.note: nominate sb for sth 提名为某奖项；appoint 是直接任命。

ex.en: A financial crisis was looming, and few people seemed to notice.
ex.zh: 一场金融危机正在逼近，似乎很少有人注意到。

words.note: loom 指庞大事物隐现或事件逼近，常与 large、over 连用。

ex.en: The bus remained stationary for ten minutes at the empty crossing.
ex.zh: 公交车在空无一人的路口停了十分钟。

words.note: stationary 静止的；stationery 是文具，拼写易混。

ex.en: She could hardly restrain her anger when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 听到这个消息时，她几乎无法克制愤怒。

words.note: restrain 强调忍住、控制；refrain 只接 from doing。

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after he asked about her former husband.
ex.zh: 他问起她前夫之后，出现了尴尬的沉默。

words.note: awkward 既指尴尬，也指动作笨拙或使用不便。

ex.en: The scandal ruined his career and he left the city for good.
ex.zh: 丑闻毁了他的事业，他永远离开了这座城市。

words.note: ruin 作动词指彻底毁掉；作名词常用复数 ruins 指废墟。

ex.en: You should book the tickets beforehand, as the show sells out fast.
ex.zh: 你应该提前订票，因为演出票卖得很快。

words.note: beforehand 是副词，不能作定语；in advance 意思相近。

ex.en: Rebuilding the bridge turned out to be a formidable task for the town.
ex.zh: 重建这座桥对小镇来说是项艰巨的任务。

words.note: formid（恐惧）+able；指因强大而令人敬畏或难对付。

ex.en: Passengers grew impatient as the delay stretched into a second hour.
ex.zh: 延误进入第二小时，乘客们变得不耐烦。

words.note: impatient 后接 with 对人，接 for 或 to do 表急切盼望。
